pr_title: GameEngine: ADR0155 managed Local AI implementation
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes deterministic ADR0155 hardening on current main: preserves legacy external-local preferences, uses Windows certutil for SHA-256 verification, and adds exact Windows launch, WSL fail-closed, and crash-before-health contract tests.

## Remaining first-release evidence

Representative measured WindowsNative versus Wsl2Linux runtime characterization is still required by ADR0155 before treating either environment as the normal product default.
